newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zeroual says Algeria facing conspiracy.
newsitem.headline: Zeroual says Algeria facing conspiracy.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual in a televised address to the nation said on Friday Algeria was facing "a wave of criminal violence and barbarous savagery" which was a "conspiracy against the country and its people".
"I confirm to the dear Algerian people the determination of the Algerian state to battle against the terrorist groups until their final eradication," Zeroual said.
The president's 20-minute speech followed bombs in and around Algiers and massacres in villages blamed by the authorities on Moslem fundamentalists.
Residents on Friday said the latest massacre was of 15 civilians on a farm just outside the capital on Thursday night.
Since January 10, when the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan started, more than 200 people have been killed. The Armed Islamic Group (GIA) had vowed to increase their attacks during Ramadan.
